units.source_text: 我独自一人坐在铺好的匠铺上，揣摩着积淀在鹿苑寺的黑夜。

en.t: I sat alone on the laid tatami floor, pondering the darkness that had settled over Rokuonji.

units.source_text: 夜渐渐增加了浓度和沉重。

en.t: The night gradually grew denser and heavier.

units.source_text: 我所在的五铺席宽的储藏室那粗大的柱子和板门支撑着这古老的夜，

en.t: The thick pillars and plank doors of the five-mat storeroom where I was seemed to support this ancient night,
and everything around was solemn and hushed.
